title.en: The buyer’s check on this page is which machine mixes and pumps when the grid is absent
title.zh: 本页要核对的是：没有电网时，哪台机器能搅拌并泵送

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints mix-and-pump and rural or self-built pouring on this diesel unit: 4108 engine 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³. Taken from the printed row: The stone rows are 100 / 300 m for the ≤ 1 inch fine-stone line, 60 / 180 m for 13 mm stone and 40 / 120 m for 24 mm stone. Keep this cell as published. Weight is 4200 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is not a mixing plant and not the electric mixer.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。柴油搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台柴油设备上印了搅拌加泵送，以及农村或自建房浇筑：4108 发动机 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³。石子行是 ≤ 1 英寸细石 100 / 300 m，13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m，24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。重量 4200 kg。它不是搅拌站，也不是电动搅拌泵。

body.en: “Hydraulic pump” breaks its subject at “Gear pumps”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The diesel mixer: 4108 diesel 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa. Read it in the Xingtai table. Weight is 4200 kg. Taken from the printed row: The electric mixer prints one distance, 100 m / 300 m, and aggregate 4 cm and below, on 45 kW + 14 kW. Keep this cell as published. Name the stone row: fine stone / ≤ 1 inch, 13 mm, or 24 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not split it into extra models on this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. Keep that order unless the page you are reading labels it differently, and do not swap in the 24 mm pair. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_pump
body.zh: 《Hydraulic pump》在“齿轮泵组”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。柴油搅拌泵：4108 柴油机 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa。细石 100 / 300 m，13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m，24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_pump

body.en: Borrow “Rotary vane pumps” from “Hydraulic pump” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. Fine-stone distance 100 / 300 m, 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m, 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m. Taken from the printed row: It is not a mixing plant and not the electric mixer. Keep this cell as published. Do not paste the electric aggregate cell onto every diesel stone row. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h and does not mix.
body.zh: 把《Hydraulic pump》的“转子叶片泵组”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：柴油搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台柴油设备上印了搅拌加泵送，以及农村或自建房浇筑：4108 发动机 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³。石子行是 ≤ 1 英寸细石 100 / 300 m，13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m，24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。重量 4200 kg。它不是搅拌站，也不是电动搅拌泵。目录里已经写着：这一格印的是 4108 / 66–75 kW。不要在本页再拆成更多型号。

body.en: The reference page “Hydraulic pump” uses “Screw pumps” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. Keep this cell as published. The long pair is the fine-stone line the English table marks as ≤ 1 inch and the Chinese table marks as fine stone. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. If the concrete arrives ready to place, you do not need this 4200 kg mixer. Read it in the Xingtai table. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Taken from the printed row: This machine prints 25 m³/h and does mix and pump.
body.zh: 来源页《Hydraulic pump》用“螺杆泵组”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。目录里已经写着：较长的那一对是英文表标成 ≤ 1 英寸、中文表标成细石的那一行。13 mm 是 60 / 180 m。24 mm 是 40 / 120 m。电动搅拌泵只印一段距离 100 m / 300 m，骨料 4 cm 及以下，电机是 45 kW + 14 kW。不要把电动的骨料格贴到柴油的每一行石子上。这一格照已印出的读：柴油40印的是 26 m³/h，而且不搅拌。这台机器印的是 25 m³/h，并且搅拌并泵送。

body.en: “Bent axis pumps” is an outline label from “Hydraulic pump”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints mix-and-pump and rural or self-built pouring on this diesel unit: 4108 engine 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 13 mm is 60 / 180 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. Off-grid placement alone is Diesel 30–120 or the compact rural machines. Taken from the printed row: Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Keep this cell as published. The electric mixer labels 100 m / 300 m as horizontal / vertical.
body.zh: “弯轴泵组”是《Hydraulic pump》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：如果混凝土到达时已经可以浇筑，就不需要这台 4200 kg 的搅拌泵。单纯的无电网浇筑是柴油30–120或紧凑农村机器。柴油搅拌泵的系列说明提到 30、40、50 的搅拌配置；本页不在已印的 25 m³/h 行之外再加输送量。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动搅拌泵把 100 m / 300 m 标成水平/垂直。柴油搅拌泵的细石格在水平/垂直行上印的是 100 / 300 m。除非你正在看的页面标法不同，保持这个顺序，并且不要换成 24 mm 那一对。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Inline axial piston pumps” from “Hydraulic pump”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The stone rows are 100 / 300 m for the ≤ 1 inch fine-stone line, 60 / 180 m for 13 mm stone and 40 / 120 m for 24 mm stone. Read it in the Xingtai table. 24 mm is 40 / 120 m. Taken from the printed row: The diesel mixer’s series note mentions 30, 40 and 50 mixer pairings; this page does not add outputs beyond the printed 25 m³/h row. Keep this cell as published. The cell is printed as 4108 / 66–75 kW. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The diesel mixer’s fine-stone cell is printed as 100 / 300 m on the H / V row.
body.zh: 本节保留《Hydraulic pump》的标题“直列轴向活塞泵组”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请点名石子行：细石 / ≤ 1 英寸、13 mm 或 24 mm。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Gear pumps” — Is 66–75 kW one engine family?
question.zh: “齿轮泵组”旁边仍要印着的是什么：66–75 kW 是一个发动机区间吗？

answer.en: The cell is printed as 4108 / 66–75 kW. Leave aside split it into extra models on this page.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。这一格印的是 4108 / 66–75 kW。不要在本页再拆成更多型号。

question.en: “Rotary vane pumps” does not change the check: Is 25 m³/h the same as Diesel 40?
question.zh: “转子叶片泵组”不改这一问：25 m³/h 和柴油40一样吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h and does not mix. This machine prints 25 m³/h and does mix and pump.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：柴油40印的是 26 m³/h，而且不搅拌。这台机器印的是 25 m³/h，并且搅拌并泵送。

question.en: Are the H/V labels 100 horizontal and 300 vertical, once the outline says “Screw pumps”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“螺杆泵组”时，水平/垂直是水平 100、垂直 300 吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The electric mixer labels 100 m / 300 m as horizontal / vertical. The diesel mixer’s fine-stone cell is printed as 100 / 300 m on the H / V row. Keep that order unless the page you are reading labels it differently, and do not swap in the 24 mm pair.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：电动搅拌泵把 100 m / 300 m 标成水平/垂直。柴油搅拌泵的细石格在水平/垂直行上印的是 100 / 300 m。除非你正在看的页面标法不同，保持这个顺序，并且不要换成 24 mm 那一对。

alt.zh: 引自来源页的参照图，放在这条目录说明旁边。
